mu_name_from: OpenMU Version075 Items/Weapons.cs:118 and mu.db's items row (group 2, index 2) name it the Flail against Item/Mace03.bmd.
why_this_one: Drop level 22: the Ice Monster and Hommerd leave it, and the Ice Queen as an excellent. See docs/devias-drops.md.
stance_from: ZzzCharacter.cpp:356-360: a sword, axe or mace that is not TwoHand (width 1) stands PLAYER_STOP_SWORD, and leaves the shield hand free.
sheet_from: Data/Item/flail02.OZJ (32x32) on 120 triangles and flail00.OZT (16x16, alpha) on 4, from MuMain.
material_note: Dark steel with a wound grip and a forged chain. flail00.tga is the chain's cut-out ring and is declared a cut-out, as the Elven Shield's wing: it is not sniffed.
cutout_note: Declared, not sniffed (tools/asset.sh reads `cutout` from the recipe). Without it the card draws as a solid quad.
material_overrides_note: Steel's own 0.2 mirrored the grass: in the studio the head went black from above and the shaft flared white at grazing sun, the Gladius's fault (black at 0.2, right at 0.55) and the Salamander's in this batch.
chain_note: Mace03.obj is not MuExtract's output as it stands: the two chain cards were cut into 9 and 10 segments by hand after export, because their v runs -4.6..4.7 and a baked atlas cannot repeat. Since 2026-10-06 it is at MU's bind pose, as a rigged model must be: flail02 is export-obj's own bind, and the cut chain was carried back from action 1's first key by bone 2's rigid transform (fitted on the card's 8 original vertices, error 6e-6). The chain is all bone 2, so Mace03.rig.json lists the 42 cut vertices Blender imports (of the OBJ's 50, eight used by no face) on bone 2 where export-rig wrote 8.
bake_share_note: The chain's nineteen rings are one 16-px ring drawn nineteen times; clean_lowpoly.match_density counted each at full weight and gave them four fifths of the map, squeezing the head and grip into a strip. At 0.05 the chain claims about one tile's room, as MU's sheet does.
held_from: MuMain plays the Flail's own rig (ZzzCharacter.cpp:10107-10118): action 1 while held, at PLAYER_STOP_MALE's PlaySpeed 0.28 -- 7 keys a second round its 7 keys, one cycle a second (held_clip 1, held_loop 1) -- and action 2 in a sword swing, PLAYER_ATTACK_SWORD_RIGHT1 and 2, at that attack's own PlaySpeed, so keyed to the swing (swing_clip 2, Figure::poseHeld). Action 0 is the bind, the ball folded back onto the grip, which MU never shows held. Until 2026-10-06 the flail was built rigid, frozen at action 1's first key; the user: 'some of crosbows and bows was kind of "alive"'.
rig_note: Mace03.rig.json from export-rig --actions=all: five bones, three 7-key actions (0 the bind, 1 held, 2 the swing); bones 1 and 2 are the chain and the ball. Its flail00 entry edited, see chain_note. Slung on the back MU draws it frozen on action 0's first key (ZzzCharacter.cpp:15326-15334); here too, the ball folded against the grip (Figure::poseHeld), on the generic sword placement (RenderLinkObject's (70, 0, 90) and (-20, 5, 40), :6826-6829 and :6906-6910; kWeaponOnBack) -- MU has no case of its own for it. Run on, the chain swung out from the back with the ball in the air beside him; frozen on action 1 it hung out to his side; turned end over end and moved it was ours, and the user chose MU's (2026-10-06: 'something looked wierd on that flail weapon on back', then "MU's: generic placement, ball folded up over the shoulder").

islands.note: a chain strip on flail00.tga: the 16-px ring, cut out (41% away), once per segment. MU tiles it ~9-10 times down one quad; the source OBJ cuts the quad into that many segments so the bake can carry every ring (see the OBJ's own comment). Forged links.

the crossing chain strip on flail00.tga: the 16-px ring, cut out (41% away), once per segment. MU tiles it ~9-10 times down one quad; the source OBJ cuts the quad into that many segments so the bake can carry every ring (see the OBJ's own comment). Forged links.
the collar and upper head, 23 to 48 along: blue-grey (113,118,122 to 163,171,174) with near-black shadows.
the grip, -24 to 11: the tan-and-cream diamond strip down flail02's right side (254,220,157; 146,76,17; a 27,0,0 crease). A wound grip, the pattern crossing the width.
the head and its spikes, 98 of the 124 triangles: dark teal-black steel (17,27,29 to 164,179,186 on the highlights).
